_comment: Hard ceilings for the self-editing strategy loop. Nothing in strategy/ may propose a value outside these bounds, and the loop must never touch this file itself — only an operator: commit may change it. Mirrors Phil's config/protected.json.

realExecution.note: ORB has no automated order placement today (trade-log.md is discretionary, filled from alerts). This flag exists so it stays false unless an operator commit deliberately flips it, the same tripwire Phil's real_trading_enabled provides.
